headline: ‘That is not acceptable’: Judge orders Google to make rival app store installs easier
summary: Judge orders Google to ease rival app store installations on Android. Decision stems from Epic Games' antitrust lawsuit. Follows a jury's finding of anti-competitive practices.

headline: The fight over Flock and other ALPRs
summary: Over 120,000 Flock ALPR cameras monitor US vehicles. AI-powered systems track cars by license plate, model, and color. Concerns grow over widespread surveillance and privacy implications.

headline: Microsoft’s Clippy-like Mico character is no longer the face of Copilot
summary: Microsoft is retiring Mico, the yellow blob character, from Copilot. The emotive avatar will no longer appear in Copilot's voice mode. Mico is being relocated to Microsoft's Learn Live platform.

headline: Netflix is closing two game studios
summary: Netflix is shutting down two of its internal game studios. Night School Studio, known for Oxenfree, is among those closing. The move signals a shift towards party games and TV streaming titles.

headline: 'It Doesn't Make Sense' — Uncharted Designer Doesn't Want a Remake of Drake's Fortune
summary: An original Uncharted designer opposes a Drake's Fortune remake. Benson Russell believes a remake 'doesn't make sense.' His skepticism highlights creative concerns for potential reboots.

headline: The FED Fitness DS2 Adjustable Dumbbells Can Turn Into an Adjustable Kettlebell or Barbell for Just $56.60
summary: FED Fitness DS2 offers adjustable dumbbells for $56.60. They transform into a kettlebell, barbell, and pushup stands. Provides a versatile all-in-one workout solution.

headline: The Thin and Light Gigabyte AERO X16 16" Gaming Laptop Is Perfect for Students Heading Back to School
summary: Gigabyte AERO X16 is a thin, light 16" gaming laptop. Weighing 4.2 pounds, it offers strong gaming performance. Ideal for students returning to school.

headline: Magic's New Foundations Commander Decks Are Worth Buying — Here's Why I'm So Excited
summary: Magic: The Gathering's new Foundations Commander decks are launching. The $30 precons are praised as a must-buy. Recommended for both new and experienced MTG players.

headline: Two seriously hurt as passenger train derails in East Sussex
summary: A passenger train derailed in East Sussex, seriously injuring two. Witnesses described 'pandemonium' as the carriage rocked. Emergency services responded to the incident.

headline: Watch: Aerial footage shows homes engulfed in flames in Stourbridge
summary: Aerial footage reveals homes engulfed by fires in Stourbridge. Multiple blazes caused widespread destruction across the West Midlands. The devastating fires destroyed residential properties.

headline: UK sees hottest day of the year as 38.1C recorded in Kew Gardens
summary: The UK experienced its hottest day of the year at 38.1C. The record temperature was set in Kew Gardens. An amber extreme heat warning remains in effect for parts of England.

headline: Five key takeaways from results day 2026
summary: Results Day 2026 shows an increase in top grades achieved. More students are gaining university admissions. Technical subjects are experiencing a rise in popularity.
